incidents.summary: Entain agreed to pay £615 million under a court-approved deferred prosecution agreement resolving alleged failures to prevent bribery at its former Turkish business.

sources.title: Entain reaches final approval on deferred prosecution agreement with CPS
sources.quote: A High Court judge officially approved a deferred prosecution agreement (DPA) between Entain and the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) on Tuesday to settle an HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) investigation into the company.

sources.title: Entain reaches final approval on deferred prosecution agreement with CPS
sources.quote: Entain had reached an agreement with HMRC to pay a penalty of £585 million plus a further £10 million to cover the investigation and a £20 million charitable donation, which will be paid out over a four-year period.

sources.title: Entain
sources.quote: the conduct which is the subject of the DPA relates to alleged failure by GVC to prevent bribery contrary to Section 7 of the Bribery Act 2010 between July 2011 and December 2017.

incidents.summary: AUSTRAC commenced civil penalty proceedings against Entain's Australian subsidiary alleging systemic anti-money-laundering failures and inadequate board and senior-management oversight.

sources.title: Entain – to Federal Court over serious non-compliance ... - AUSTRAC
sources.quote: Today, AUSTRAC commenced civil penalty proceedings in the Federal Court against Entain Group Pty Ltd (Entain), which operates online betting sites including Ladbrokes, Neds and other online betting brands.

sources.title: Entain – to Federal Court over serious non-compliance ... - AUSTRAC
sources.quote: The proceedings allege serious and systemic non-compliance with Australia’s anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing (AML/CTF) laws.

sources.title: Entain – to Federal Court over serious non-compliance ... - AUSTRAC
sources.quote: Entain’s board and senior management did not have appropriate oversight of its AML/CTF program, which limited its ability to identify the ML/TF risks it faced and its vulnerability to criminal exploitation.

positives: Entain contributed £18.7 million to UK gambling research, education and treatment.
Entain purchased just under 100% of its UK and Republic of Ireland electricity from renewable sources.
